# Home Appliance Cost Guide

> Plain-English repair pricing, home warranty breakdowns, and repair-vs-replace guides for US homeowners. Honest, brand-agnostic appliance cost guides updated for 2026.

Home Appliance Cost Guide helps US homeowners make informed decisions when appliances break. The site covers real repair pricing across major brands, explains what home warranties actually cover (and what they exclude), provides error-code lookups for common appliance failures, and offers practical repair-vs-replace decision frameworks backed by appliance lifespan data. All content is researched from national service-call data, manufacturer-authorized parts pricing, and ongoing technician interviews.

- [Home Warranty Guides](/category/home-warranty-guides): What's covered, what's excluded, coverage caps, and how to read your contract.

- [Appliance Error Codes](/category/appliance-error-codes): Decode error codes from major brands and understand typical repair costs for each.
